prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You have my claim information on file.

Q: That's fine, we'll reference the claim file. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, near a shopping center. I was in the right lane heading toward the freeway access.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes to the left because I needed to get over for my turn. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I didn't see anything there.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until we made contact. It came up on my left side and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jolt.

Q: Did you stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away. The other driver stopped too and we exchanged information.

Q: How are you feeling since the accident?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to look over my shoulder. My lower back aches when I sit for long periods. I went to urgent care the same day and they diagnosed a neck and back strain.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm going to physical therapy twice a week and I'm taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor said to expect a few weeks of recovery.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful and I believe the other vehicle moved into my lane. I just want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of.
